address: Shop 605, 6F, Crystal Galleria, 68 Yuyuan Road, Jingan, Shanghai, Chinese Mainland
bio: The owner is a seafood vendor himself, so only the freshest catch makes it to the table. Without bells and whistles, the food is traditional Wenzhou fare that highlights natural flavours. Wild-caught marine fish, steamed and served chilled with salted potherb mustard greens and Puning soybean paste, imparts layers of flavour. A Wenzhou street-food classic, the pork wonton soup brings back childhood memories. Certain items need to be pre-ordered.
